maria: Hey @eng-security — I need a short console elevation to remove a few lines containing PII from analytics logs for ticket INF-412. It's a quick psql scrub on analytics-prod. Need ~30m. Can someone approve and share the JIT steps?

security-bot: Automated check — please include justification, exact DB/table, time window, and requested duration. See runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.example/priv-access.

alex: Quick checklist: 1) exact DB/table, 2) exact time window, 3) confirm no data export, 4) who will run it. Also tag request with `temporary-elev`.

maria: DB: analytics-prod, table: user_events. Time window: 2026-03-10 00:00–02:00 UTC. No export — just deleting rows with SSN-like values detected by the redaction job. I (maria) will run it. Duration requested: 30m. Command I plan to run:
```bash
psql -h analytics-prod -U redwood_ops -c "DELETE FROM user_events WHERE id IN (12345,12346);"
```
I will capture output and paste to INF-412.

samir: I can provision just-in-time console elevation for mariato run the command for 30m, pending security sign-off.

alex: SGTM. Conditional approval: 30m max, run under `audit-debug` session, stream stdout to the ticket, and do a quick VACUUM if needed.

maria: tagging @devops-oncall for the port-forward/bastion step and to request the JIT role injection.

devops-oncall: I will open a transient port-forward and inject the `temporary-elev` role for 30m. Steps I recommend:
1) SSH via bastion: `ssh -J bastion ops@analytics-db`
2) Local port-forward if needed: `ssh -L 5432:analytics-db:5432 -J bastion ops@jump`
3) Use psql locally: `psql -h localhost -p 5432 -U redwood_ops analytics_prod`
I'll start the window at the requested time (14:10 UTC) once security confirms.

maria: Starting at 14:10 UTC. I'll post when done. Thanks! :thumbsup:

security-bot: Audit event recorded — access_request=3101234567 user=maria scope=analytics-prod duration=30m approvers=[alex,samir] ticket=INF-412 note="no export; scrub only"

maria: Completed at 14:25 UTC. Deleted two rows, pasted truncated psql output to INF-412, and confirmed no exports. Closing request. :white_check_mark:
